mechanism: Isocarboxazid (MAOI) may potentiate hypotensive effects and increase risk of serotonergic syndrome if zoledronic acid is used with concurrent serotonergic medications; additionally, both agents can affect bone metabolism and electrolyte balance.
action: Monitor blood pressure closely, assess for signs of serotonin syndrome, ensure adequate hydration during zoledronic acid infusion, and consider timing separation if clinically feasible.
